additions25.note: 45 desktop section components added 30 Sep 2026 (Figma 2.5). Not in the 2.0 file. Build each as its own component named exactly as "name" — additions only; never modify, merge into, or restructure existing 2.0 components. Mobile variants not yet drawn: build Desktop only and leave Breakpoint=Mobile for a later pass (use reference/cp-static-mobile.js rules if asked).

components.name: 2.5 / CTA / Footer image band
behavior: Buttons: Primary darkens to #003D84 on hover; outlined buttons get a 12% fill of their outline colour.
components.intent: Full-bleed photo band with overlaid centered CTA. Blue primary button on dark.

components.name: 2.5 / Split Content / Products intro
behavior: Text link: bar fills left → right to the label width on hover, Orange #FF8600, 400ms ease.
components.intent: Two-Column 50/50. Heading left, body + CTA right. Standard light panel split.

components.name: 2.5 / Split Content / Product detail + spec table
components.intent: Two-Column with a spec table (label / value rows on hairline dividers). Product photo left.

components.name: 2.5 / Cards / Insights feed · Filterable
behavior: FILTER. Chips (All / Articles / Podcasts / Webinars) filter the grid by content type; one active at a time, All by default.
Active chip in Orange. Grid re-flows without a page reload.
components.intent: New — filterable 3-up grid. Type badges: Article / Podcast / Webinar. Click the filter pills above the grid.

components.name: 2.5 / Carousel / Image + content · 3-up
behavior: CAROUSEL. ‹ › arrows move one card at a time; arrows dim to 30% at either end (no loop).
Mobile: swipe row with pagination dots.
components.intent: 3 columns separated by 2px white gap. Each column: image → static accent bar (3px, Blue/Orange alternating) → type + date → uppercase bold title → body → Read More. The Read More track runs the full column width for structure; the short accent bar marks the label and fills on hover. Prev/Next arrows navigate. Used on Insights index, Projects index, and featured content strips.

components.name: 2.5 / Carousel / Image + content · 4-up
behavior: CAROUSEL. ‹ › arrows move one card at a time; arrows dim at the ends (no loop).
Mobile: swipe row with dots.
components.intent: Same card anatomy as 3-up but four columns. Use on wider content areas.

components.name: 2.5 / Carousel / Product highlights
behavior: CAROUSEL. Arrows and dots advance the slide; the active dot is the orange 26×6 pill.
Eyebrow and body copy change with the slide.
components.intent: Interactive — arrows and dots advance the slide. Use for product highlight reels.

components.name: 2.5 / Lists / Product category list
behavior: Each item is a link to its product page; hover turns it Orange.
components.intent: Products index — 4-column. Typos fixed (Infinite Facade, Glass & Glazing).

components.name: 2.5 / Icon Module / 4-col
behavior: Static.
components.intent: Icon + headline + description. 2/3/4-col variants fold behind a layout prop. Maps to Services / Capabilities List component.

components.name: 2.5 / Promo / Tagline statement band
behavior: Static.
components.intent: One-Column centered statement. Lead-scale, bold keyword. Sits on white.

components.name: 2.5 / Promo / Content promo band · Podcast
behavior: Band links to the Podcast index.
Buttons: Primary darkens to #003D84 on hover; outlined buttons get a 12% fill of their outline colour.
components.intent: New — full-width dark promotional band. Eyebrow + headline left, CTA right. Used on homepage for podcast; works for any content promotion (webinar, guide, event).

components.name: 2.5 / Promo / Content promo band · Webinar
behavior: Band links to the webinar detail / registration.
Buttons: Primary darkens to #003D84 on hover; outlined buttons get a 12% fill of their outline colour.
components.intent: New — full-width dark promotional band. Eyebrow + headline left, CTA right. Used on homepage for podcast; works for any content promotion (webinar, guide, event).

components.name: 2.5 / CTA / Asset download block
behavior: Button downloads the asset directly (spec sheet, guide or whitepaper).
Buttons: Primary darkens to #003D84 on hover; outlined buttons get a 12% fill of their outline colour.
components.intent: New — configurable for any spec sheet, guide, or whitepaper. Thumbnail left, description + download CTA right.

components.name: 2.5 / Stats Row / Accent dividers
behavior: Static.
components.intent: White background. Dark numerals, gray body, orange accent dividers between sections.

components.name: 2.5 / Project Detail / Spec panel
behavior: "+6" thumbnail opens a full-screen lightbox gallery.
Clicking any thumbnail swaps the main photo.
components.intent: New — structured sidebar for project detail pages. Photo + thumbnail strip left; key/value spec rows + product badges right.

components.name: 2.5 / Careers / Open positions list
behavior: FILTER. Department tabs filter the list (underline indicator on the active tab).
Each job row links out to the posting in the ATS.
components.intent: Filter tab row (underline indicator) + job rows. Each row: title + dept tag + location + type pill + "Apply →" CTA. Interactive — clicking filters shows matching jobs only. Rows on 1px #DEDFE0 dividers.

components.name: 2.5 / Sustainability / Sustainable callout
behavior: Static.
components.intent: Green keyword — the sanctioned exception (sustainability content). Two-Column 50/50.

components.name: 2.5 / Sustainability / Stats band
behavior: Static. Confirm the 40% cement figure with Clark Pacific before launch.
components.intent: Converted to the light treatment August 2026 — the dark band is retired, and a stats row carries no CTA, so it is not a sanctioned coloured surface. Same anatomy as the canonical Stats Row (Simple Dividers): white surface between top and bottom #DEDFE0 hairlines, 1px divider between cells, SemiBold Dark Charcoal numerals. The Green accent bar is kept — this is sustainability content.

components.name: 2.5 / Sustainability / EPD + credentials grid
behavior: Each credential tile links to its PDF.
components.intent: Open 2×2 grid on white, 28px gutters (the #F0F0F0 hairline field was retired August 2026 — the fill now sits only on the individual credential boxes, which is the sanctioned use). Each box: white 64×64 icon card (green checkmark) + SemiBold uppercase title + body. Use for third-party certifications, green building contributions, or verified claims.

components.name: 2.5 / About / Timeline · Horizontal
behavior: Scrolls horizontally at narrow widths; show a fade at the right edge to hint more.
components.intent: Horizontal milestone strip, horizontally scrollable at narrow widths. Connecting line at node center. Each node: filled circle (filled = key milestone, outline = standard) + year + uppercase title + caption body. First/last nodes use brand colors.

components.name: 2.5 / About / Territory map
behavior: Static image — Clark Pacific to supply the map artwork.
components.intent: Schematic SVG map: two CA plants (West Sacramento HQ + Woodland), Pacific NW expansion in 2026. Primary service territory shaded Blue, expansion area shaded Orange. Legend + stat callouts to the right. Used on About Us and Contact pages.

components.name: 2.5 / Insights / Filter bar
behavior: FILTER. Underline tab row filters the list below; active tab gets the 2px bar.
components.intent: Underline-indicator tab row. Active tab: #52565A text + 2px bottom border. Inactive: #7F8A92. Used on Webinars, In the News, and Podcast index pages. Horizontally scrollable at narrow widths.

components.name: 2.5 / Insights / Webinar card · List
behavior: Whole card links to the webinar detail page. Badge reads On Demand or Upcoming.
components.intent: Horizontal list card. 320px dark video thumbnail left with play button + "On Demand" badge. Right: category tag + title + date (if applicable) + description + "Watch Now →". Rows separated by 1px #DEDFE0 dividers. Stacks vertically in a bordered container.

components.name: 2.5 / Insights / Content archive · Paginated
behavior: FILTER + SEARCH + PAGINATION. Type chips filter; search narrows; result count updates.
Numbered pagination with prev/next; prev/next dim at the ends. Page change scrolls to the list top.
components.intent: Paginated list for In the News and Resources index pages. Search bar + content-type filter chips + result count + sorted row list (thumbnail · type badge · title · date · excerpt · CTA) + numbered pagination. Interactive — filter chips and pagination are JS-driven. 5 items per page.

components.name: 2.5 / Products / Sub-category card grid
behavior: Whole card is the link; the underline animates on hover.
components.intent: 2×2 (or 2×1) grid of product sub-category cards. Each: 16:9 photo placeholder + eyebrow (product type) + bold uppercase title + description + animated underline text link. All cards white with a 1px #DEDFE0 outline and 28px gutters — the alternating BG Alt fills and 1px-packed gutters are retired (June 2026).

components.name: 2.5 / Products / Structural components strip
behavior: Scrolls horizontally when items overflow.
components.intent: Horizontal scrollable strip inside a bordered container. Each item: 64×64px BG Alt icon cell + SemiBold uppercase label below. 1px #DEDFE0 right dividers. White background, equal column widths. Used on Data Centers page to list structural components (L Beams, R Beams, etc.).

components.name: 2.5 / Products / Product intro · Infinite Facade®
behavior: Text link: bar fills left → right to the label width on hover, Orange #FF8600, 400ms ease.
components.intent: Brand-neutral eyebrow — Infinite Facade® uses the standard palette. Two-Column 50/50 with product imagery, on white.

components.name: 2.5 / Products / Finish grid · Infinite Facade®
behavior: "View finishes guide" text link — Orange hover.
components.intent: Ten finish swatches. "View finishes guide" text-link uses the Orange accent bar — left-aligned, fills on hover.

components.name: 2.5 / Stats Row / Light · Infinite Facade®
behavior: Static.
components.intent: White background — the only stats surface. The dark stats band is retired (June 2026): all modules sit on white. Extra-large bold numerals (92px), equal column padding, hairline dividers.

components.name: 2.5 / Sustainability / Video + bullet highlights
behavior: Play button plays the video inline.
components.intent: Green keyword — sanctioned exception for sustainability content. Video thumbnail left, bullet points right.

components.name: 2.5 / Sustainability / Initiatives list
behavior: Static.
components.intent: Green applied. Two columns, six distinct sustainability initiatives with icon wells.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Filter bar
behavior: FILTER + SEARCH. Category chips and Region chips combine (AND). Search narrows further.
"Showing N projects" count updates live; badges use the category colours (Parking Orange, Envelope Blue, Data Centers gray).
components.intent: Full-width interactive filter for the Projects index. Search bar first (users frequently search by product name), then product-type pills (filled #52565A = active, #F0F0F0 = inactive) + Region row. Live filtered project count. Grid updates to match. Used at the top of the Projects index page, above the project card grid.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Project card grid
behavior: Whole card is the link; the photo darkens slightly on hover.
components.intent: 4:3 photo with embedded product badge (top-left — category colors: Parking = Orange, Building Envelope / Facades = Blue, Data Centers & Structural = Dark Charcoal until a color is chosen) + 3px Orange accent bar + bold uppercase title + industry · region metadata + "View Project →". Used on Projects index and related projects strips.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Resource card · 4 variants
behavior: Video variants: play overlay opens the video in a lightbox. Format badge sits top-left.
components.intent: 3:2 photo with optional video play button overlay + format badge (filled = primary type, outlined = secondary) + product category + uppercase title + excerpt + CTA. Used on Resources index. Format badges: Webinar/Podcast use outlined; Datasheet/Case Study/Guide use filled.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Featured blog post
behavior: Whole block links to the post.
components.intent: 16:9 image left (1.2fr) + right column: "Featured" dark badge, category + date, bold title, excerpt, "Read Article →". Used at top of Blog index, on white.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Detail sidebar trio
behavior: Photo gallery: thumbnail click swaps the main photo; "+N" opens a lightbox.
Facts & Figures and Project Team are static.
components.intent: Three sidebar components used together on Project Detail pages: Photo Gallery (main + 5 thumbnails), Facts & Figures spec table, Project Team credits. All use 1px #DEDFE0 border containers with #F0F0F0 header band.

components.name: 2.5 / Projects / Overview accordion · Alt detail
behavior: EXPANDABLE LIST. Three sections — Project Overview, Facts & Figures, Project Team. Click a header to open it; opening one closes the others.
Project Overview is open on load. Sign flips + → –.
components.intent: Alternate detail layout: photo gallery left, accordion right (same 1.5/1 split as the sidebar trio). The page leads with an expandable Project Overview — the written project description (not every project has a formal case study) — with Facts & Figures and Project Team collapsed beneath. Opening one section collapses the others. Interactive — click the section headers.
